text:
raj: Quick thread — we need to decide how retries at the edge should be attributed in metrics and what we surface to clients. Two problems: (1) billing/units and SLA math when gateway retries upstream, (2) what HTTP semantics we return if upstream error vs edge exhaustion. Thoughts?
taylor: We should distinguish user-originated retries (client replays) vs gateway-hedges. For billing, only charge once for successful final response, but we need to expose counts for capacity planning.
ellie: For streaming requests this gets nastier — partial output may have been sent. If gateway retries mid-stream, we either: a) resume (if idempotent/kv-cache), b) present partial+error, or c) perform a transparent background retry and switch sockets. Each has tradeoffs.
samir: Proposal: add hop headers + idempotency token. Gateway sets X-Rwd-Edge-Retry: 1..n and X-Rwd-Edge-Idempotency: <uuid>. Upstream includes X-Rwd-Processing-Units so we can attribute cost per hop. Keep billing based on final upstream that completed the call, but record the attempted_units metric for observability.
michael: +1 on hop headers, but be careful leaking internal headers to client. We should strip them before responding, unless client specifically asks for Debug headers via ?rwd_debug=1 or Accept-Debug.
ellie: For streaming resume, we should only auto-retry if the model/runtime exposes a resume_token and the client request included an idempotency token. Otherwise return a truncated stream and an explicit error trailer: 
```
--trailer--
Rwd-Stream-Status: partial
Rwd-Partial-Bytes: 4096
Rwd-Error: upstream-timeout
```
That lets clients decide to re-request with the same idempotency token and the service can attempt resume.
lia: What about SLAs? If edge retries silently, client p99 latency looks fine but upstream sees more load. Ops wants a separate metric: edge.retry.cpu_units and edge.retry-response-latency so we can correlate hedging behavior with cost.
ops-bot: alert: edge_retry_rate > 0.05 for prod us-east-1 — sample trace id=abc123.
raj: OK good — action items: (1) RFC to add X-Rwd-Edge-Retry and X-Rwd-Edge-Idempotency headers (internal-only by default), (2) spec for stream-trailer error fields and resume_token contract, (3) metrics: attempted_processing_units, completed_processing_units, edge_retry_attempts, edge_retry_latency. I'll draft an RFC and ping infra for KMS safe idempotency generation.
taylor: One more: gate automatic retries by request flags — allowlist types (text-gen, embeddings) and opt-out via header X-Rwd-Retry-Policy: none|failover|hedge. Defaults: failover for sync, hedge for low-Latency routes.
raj: Perfect. I'll open the RFC and add sample headers + a tiny YAML snippet for the metric names. :thumbsup:
